x: Stone was second, with Henderson (Worthing and District S.C.), third. Our boys were in the same position, except Paul, who was having trouble and had dropped a few places.
Henderson, winner of the London—Brighton and Back Walk earlier in the season, walked steadily throughout to finish second.
Henderson, after taking the lead from Sutton, went well ahead and it seemed impossible to catch him. He was pegged back, however, and the leadership was continually changing.
